title: jdssv-dagcheck-replication: code and data for "Exploratory Diagnostics for Optimisation in Continuous Causal Structure Learning: When Stability Conceals Solver Failure"
description: The dagcheck Python package and the full replication materials (analysis scripts, results, and data) for the paper "Exploratory Diagnostics for Optimisation in Continuous Causal Structure Learning: When Stability Conceals Solver Failure", submitted to the Journal of Data Science, Statistics, and Visualisation (JDSSV).
